---
title: "revealjs: layout panels"
format: revealjs
# A deck lays `layout-ncol`, `layout-nrow` and `layout` Divs out in rows and
# cells, with the same markup as an HTML page (Quarto 1 `layout/html.lua`
# serves both). A heading inside a panel becomes a bold paragraph at the top
# of the next cell, because a deck would read it as a slide title. A panel
# image sits in a cell, so auto-stretch leaves it alone. The fourth slide is
# the case of Quarto 1's crossrefs/float/revealjs/revealjs-subfloat-1.qmd,
# less the sub-figure numbering.
_quarto:
  tests:
    revealjs:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'section#two-columns div.quarto-layout-panel[data-layout-ncol="2"] > div.quarto-layout-row:only-child > div.quarto-layout-cell[style="flex-basis: 50.0%;justify-content: flex-start;"]:nth-child(2)'
          - 'section#two-rows div.quarto-layout-panel > div.quarto-layout-row:nth-child(2):last-child > div.quarto-layout-cell:nth-child(2)'
          - 'section#custom div.quarto-layout-row:first-child > div.quarto-layout-cell[style="flex-basis: 50.0%;justify-content: flex-start;"]:nth-child(2):last-child'
          - 'section#custom div.quarto-layout-row:nth-child(2) > div.quarto-layout-cell[style="flex-basis: 100.0%;justify-content: flex-start;"]:only-child'
          - 'section#a-figure div#fig-pair.quarto-layout-panel > figure > div > div.quarto-layout-row > div.quarto-layout-cell:nth-child(2)'
          - 'section#a-figure div#fig-pair > figure > figcaption'
          - 'section#headings div.quarto-layout-cell:first-child > p:first-child > strong'
          - 'section#headings div.quarto-layout-cell:nth-child(2) > p:first-child > strong'
        - - 'section div.quarto-layout-panel h3'
          - 'section div.quarto-layout-panel img.r-stretch'
          - 'section > img'
      ensureCssRegexMatches:
        - - '\.quarto-layout-row\s*\{[^}]*display:\s*flex'
          - '\.quarto-layout-cell\s*\{[^}]*margin-right:\s*20px'
        - []
---
